description:
Read supported ride services, required facts and the selected service location's timeZone. Call before collecting a new ride; follow with get_customer_policy for eligibility, quote_ride for price, then prepare_offer only for an explicitly requested offer.

Omitting offerKey selects the published default. Otherwise retain the same known published key across policy, pricing and preparation; a key must still match the current publication/catalog. locale selects translated labels and links independently: changing de to en keeps the location, whereas changing offerKey requires rereading timeZone before interpreting a clock time.

available reports capabilities and collection requirements, not vehicle inventory or held capacity. This uncached read consumes no quote admission; reread before quoting. Correct invalid_request facts; unavailable leaves service scope unverified.

locale.description: Use the customer's requested language for text and booking links: en by default, de for German. Preserve it on retries; pickup times stay in the provider time zone.

offerKey.description: Optional existing published provider/supplier offer key. Selects its configured service location; it is not a customer bookingKey or bookingReference and grants no booking access.
